prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept.
Asset type: original wide 16:9 environmental image for the header and ambient backdrop of an internal Benny's Motors sales dashboard; no interface embedded.
Primary request: Create a cinematic Halloween night version of the ACTUAL Benny's garage shown in the three location-reference screenshots. Faithful recognizable GTA roleplay workshop architecture with colorful graffiti, rendered with premium detailed lighting in burgundy and crimson.
Input images: image 1 primary wide interior reference showing blue mezzanine/staircase, center red Benny's shutter, steel trusses/white ducts, colorful murals, polished floor, raised green lowrider on a blue lift at right and red/black tool cabinets; image 2 supports workshop scale, tire racks and opposite murals; image 3 supports yellow mezzanine railings, lowrider bay, tool cabinets and colorful paint. These are architectural references, not interface targets.
Scene: same recognizable broad interior, blue stairs and mezzanine to left, red shutter with white Benny's branding in depth, green classic lowrider on the lift on right, the original vibrant graffiti walls, tire racks and drawers. Clean up blown highlights and camera blur from the game capture, create consistent beautiful night lighting. No people or cropped player vehicle in foreground. A few carved pumpkins at the base of the stairs and beside a tool cabinet, subtle cobwebs on upper corners, red-tinted low fog hugging the floor. Halloween environmental dressing, not a haunted theme park. No Día de Muertos.
Composition: broad cinematic landscape, near floor and center-left quieter and darker enough for an optional HTML heading; workshop identity reads in middle and right. Crisp coherent architecture, no collage. Balanced lighting rather than complete darkness. Maintain original objects and graffiti vocabulary; no fantasy hangar, no generic all-black showroom.
Color/style: realistic high-end game environmental render, wine-black shadows #100B10/#35101E, crimson practical light #BE354E washing structural edges, neutral white fill and dark burgundy reflections on polished concrete. Original graffiti hues remain distinguishable in the shadows, green lowrider retains green paint. Tasteful small amber jack-o'-lantern glow. Not blue cyberpunk, no heavy mechanical sci-fi styling.
Text: only original in-scene Benny's branding naturally on shutter, no interface, no labels, no extra promotional text, no Los Santos footer caption, no server capture logo or 'ORIGEN ROLEPLAY' overlay, no watermark. Avoid skulls, skeletons, decorative gears, holographic screens, excessive particles, plastic toy materials, overexposed lights.
